FINAL SQL:
WITH winner_counts AS (
    SELECT winner_id, COUNT(*) AS match_count
    FROM matches
    GROUP BY winner_id
),
top_winner AS (
    SELECT winner_id
    FROM winner_counts
    ORDER BY match_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
latest_ranking AS (
    SELECT player_id, ranking_points
    FROM rankings
    WHERE ranking_date = (SELECT MAX(ranking_date) FROM rankings)
)
SELECT p.first_name || ' ' || p.last_name AS winner_name, lr.ranking_points
FROM top_winner tw
JOIN players p ON p.player_id = tw.winner_id
JOIN latest_ranking lr ON lr.player_id = tw.winner_id;
